sloka: दारूणि परिभिन्नानि वनजैः उपजीविभिः ।भरद्वाज आश्रमे च एते दृश्यन्ते विविधा द्रुमाः ॥२-५४-७॥
transliteration: dārūṇi paribhinnāni vanajaiḥ upajīvibhiḥ ।bharadvāja āśrame ca ete dṛśyante vividhā drumāḥ ॥2-54-7॥

translations.english: Here are logs of wood cut into pieces by forestdwellers, living on forest products. You can see various trees near the hermitage of sage Bharadwaja.
